description: Confirms that the preparation phase discovers models (model value, never alias), creates/selects the canvas (--use; canvas ls never switches), uploads material with persisted resourceIds, imports material as canvas nodes, and enforces the node:/res: reference discipline — all free, with no generation.
expectations: --model values come from the live model list/find payload; aliases are never passed as parameters
canvas create --use returns projectId and webUrl; canvas ls is read-only and never switches the current canvas
resource upload returns a lowercase canonical resourceId that is persisted immediately
Material intended as a generation reference is imported via node create image --resource-id <id> --import-kind local_upload
node:<nodeId> references are preferred for on-canvas material to preserve upstream/downstream relations; res:<resourceId> freezes external material
This Skill never runs --run, quote, or confirm; preparation is free-only
The deliverable is the ID set (projectId/nodeId/resourceId) plus candidate model values handed to the generation task skills
